task: Fix real bug: the drag handle was silently 48px tall (base.css's shared button min-height:48px overriding height:24px), leaving a dead gap above Quick Controls

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: Added min-height:0 to .quickPanelHandle -- base.css's shared 'button { min-height: 48px }' rule wins over a smaller height whenever both apply, so the handle was actually rendering at 48px despite height:24px, doubling its real height and creating a visible gap before the Quick Controls card. Confirmed via getBoundingClientRect before/after (48px -> 24px).

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Added an assertion for the min-height:0 override.
